tier_should.rationale: Large preregistered RCT on U.S. one-off cash transfers with administrative and survey outcomes; credible null/negative impacts challenge prevailing beliefs and delineate mechanisms (subjective vs objective). Important policy relevance; methods sound; contribution fits top applied micro/public journals.

tier_will.rationale: Null results and short horizon reduce splash; framing as prediction-versus-outcome helps. Still policy-relevant with strong design and sample. Likely lands in solid/top field applied micro or public policy outlet, not general-interest.
